```{r}
#imported manually cleaned emotion verb fluency data (removed filler phrases, spelling fixed)
ew=read.csv("Processed Data/Level0_output/deid_emoverb_raw_cleaned.csv")
ew=ew[,-1]
```

```{r}
stopwords=read.csv("stopwords_emv.csv") #customized stopwords list
stopwords=stopwords$stopword
text = ew$Q1.Transcription
docs <- Corpus(VectorSource(text))
toSpace <- content_transformer(function (x , pattern ) gsub(pattern, " ", x))
docs <- tm_map(docs, toSpace, "/")
docs <- tm_map(docs, toSpace, "@")
docs <- tm_map(docs, toSpace, "\\|")
# Convert the text to lower case
docs <- tm_map(docs, content_transformer(tolower))
# Remove numbers
docs <- tm_map(docs, removeNumbers)
# Remove customized stopwords
docs <- tm_map(docs, removeWords, stopwords)
# Remove punctuations
replacePunctuation <- content_transformer(function(x) {return (gsub("[[:punct:]]","", x))})
docs <- tm_map(docs, replacePunctuation)
# Eliminate extra white spaces
docs <- tm_map(docs, stripWhitespace)

e_words = unlist(docs)
e_words = e_words[-length(e_words)] #remove the dummy last element
ew$Final_EmoWords = e_words
```

```{r}
#for each subject, we compute the number of total words generated and the number of unique words generated
emo.verb.fluency=data.frame()
subj=unique(ew$subjectID)
for (i in 1:nrow(ew)){
  temp=ew %>% filter (subjectID == subj[i])
  word.list=unlist(strsplit(temp$Final_EmoWords, " "))
  unique.word.list=unique(word.list)
  emo.verb.fluency[i,"subjectID"]=temp$subjectID
  emo.verb.fluency[i,"condition"]=temp$condition
  emo.verb.fluency[i,"total_word"]=length(word.list)
  emo.verb.fluency[i,"total_unique_word"]=length(unique.word.list)
}
```

```{r}
write.csv(emo.verb.fluency,"Processed Data/Level1_output/full_emo_verb_fluency.csv")
```



#check the words at the consensus events to see which are candidates to be trained

```{r}
#Conduct the basic text cleaning process
ew=read.csv("Processed Data/Level1_output/full_CEA_IdentifiedByIndividuals.csv")
ew=ew[,-1]
ew=ew %>% filter(subjectID %in% full.lab.sdt.agg.all$Participant) #keep only the lab group

stopwords=read.csv("stopwords_final.csv")
stopwords=stopwords$stopword
text = ew$word
docs <- Corpus(VectorSource(text))
toSpace <- content_transformer(function (x , pattern ) gsub(pattern, " ", x))
docs <- tm_map(docs, toSpace, "/")
docs <- tm_map(docs, toSpace, "@")
docs <- tm_map(docs, toSpace, "\\|")
# Convert the text to lower case
docs <- tm_map(docs, content_transformer(tolower))
# Remove numbers
docs <- tm_map(docs, removeNumbers)
# Remove english common stopwords
docs <- tm_map(docs, removeWords, stopwords)
# Remove punctuations
replacePunctuation <- content_transformer(function(x) {return (gsub("[[:punct:]]"," ", x))})
docs <- tm_map(docs, replacePunctuation)
# Eliminate extra white spaces
docs <- tm_map(docs, stripWhitespace)

e_words = unlist(docs)
e_words = e_words[-length(e_words)] #remove the dummy last element
ew$Final_EmoWords = e_words
ew.allwords=ew #create a copy that has entries by timestamps
```

```{r,echo=FALSE,message=FALSE,warning=FALSE}
#In some incidences, one subject may provide more than 1 word for a given event, we will split these words into independent rows. 
start_time <- Sys.time()


i=1
while(1){
  if(nchar(ew[i,'Final_EmoWords'])!=0){ #If there's a final cleaned emo labels for this critical event instance
    ew[i,'Final_EmoWords']<-str_trim(ew[i,'Final_EmoWords'])
    currentlist<-unlist(strsplit(ew[i,'Final_EmoWords'], " ", perl = TRUE)) #Form a list of all words within this label instance
    stepflag=length(currentlist)
    #If there's more than one labels in this row (i.e., pausing instance), we then isolate this row, split it into numbers of row according to labels contained, then merge it back with the rest of the data.
    if(stepflag>1){
      previouslist<-ew[1:i-1,]
      latterlist<-ew[i+1:nrow(ew),]
      temp<-ew[i,1:(ncol(ew)-1)]
      jointlist1<-temp[rep(1:nrow(temp),each=stepflag),]
      Final_EmoWords<-t(t(currentlist))
      jointlist<-cbind(jointlist1,Final_EmoWords)
      ew<-rbind(previouslist,jointlist,latterlist)
      ew=na.omit(ew)
    }
  }else stepflag=1
  i=i+stepflag
  if(is.na(ew[i,'Final_EmoWords'])) break 
}
row.names(ew)<-unlist(c(1:nrow(ew)))
end_time <- Sys.time()
end_time - start_time
```

```{r}
sas_count_full = list()
sas_count_10=list()
for (i in 1:nrow(videolist)){
  temp=subset(s2_sas_subset,video==videolist[i,1])
  temp_count=data.frame(table(temp$Lemmatized_word))
  names(temp_count)[1]="word"
  temp_subset=temp_count %>%
    arrange(desc(Freq)) %>%
    slice(1:10)
  sas_count_full[[i]]=temp_count
  names(sas_count_full)[i]=videolist[i,1]
  sas_count_10[[i]]=temp_subset
  names(sas_count_10)[i]=videolist[i,1]
}
library(data.table)
this=as.data.table(sas_count_10)
#write.csv(this,"labelgroup_top10labels.csv")
```

#generate the top most word for each CE of each video (instead of top 10 from each video)
```{r}
sas_count_byce_full = list()
#sas_count_10=list()
for (i in 1:nrow(videolist)){
  temp=subset(s2_sas_subset,video==videolist[i,1])
  temp$Critical_Event_Timestamp=as.character(temp$Critical_Event_Timestamp)
  temp.ce=unique(temp$Critical_Event_Timestamp)
  sas_count_byce=data.frame(CE=temp.ce,topword=NA)
  for (j in 1:length(temp.ce)){
    temp.subset=subset(temp,Critical_Event_Timestamp==temp.ce[j])
    temp.subset.count=data.frame(table(temp.subset$Lemmatized_word)) %>% arrange(desc(Freq))
    names(temp.subset.count)[1]="word"
    temp.top.word=as.character(temp.subset.count[1,1])
    sas_count_byce[j,"topword"]=temp.top.word
  }
  sas_count_byce_full[[i]]=sas_count_byce
  names(sas_count_byce_full)[i]=videolist[i,1]
}
library(data.table)
this=as.data.table(sas_count_byce_full)


#write.csv(this,"labelgroup_top10labels.csv")
```
